mapper.sql: a.id, a.student_id, a.counselor_id, a.mode, a.main_issue, a.contact_phone, a.expect_start, a.expect_end, a.duration_minutes, a.status, a.confirmed_at, a.confirmed_by, a.finished_at, a.cancel_reason, a.renewed_from, a.note, a.created_at, a.updated_at, a.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(u.student_id, '') AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, '') AS class_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(c.real_name, ''), c.nickname, c.username) AS counselor_name
FROM psyche_appointment a LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = a.student_id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = a.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users c ON c.id = a.counselor_id

sql.if: AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.student_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psyche_appointment (student_id, counselor_id, mode, main_issue, contact_phone, expect_start, expect_end, duration_minutes, status, confirmed_at, confirmed_by, finished_at, cancel_reason, renewed_from, note, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{counselorId}, #{mode}, #{mainIssue}, #{contactPhone}, #{expectStart}, #{expectEnd}, #{durationMinutes}, #{status}, #{confirmedAt}, #{confirmedBy}, #{finishedAt}, #{cancelReason}, #{renewedFrom}, #{note}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.expect_start DESC, a.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM psyche_appointment a WHERE a.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.status IN ('requested', 'confirmed')

SELECT a.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM psyche_appointment a LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = a.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND (sp.counselor_id = #{scope} OR a.counselor_id = #{scope}) GROUP BY a.status
